acceptance.given: The four declared Package A pytest modules and their group ownership are frozen, with targeted, Q6, and terminal command argv definitions available for inspection.

oracle.expected: A command-scope validation shows each targeted command contains only its group's declared test file, Q6 contains only applicable predecessor modules and excludes later unauthored modules, and A4 Q6 and terminal argv include all four declared modules.

Q6 includes a later test module that is not authored.
A4 Q6 or terminal omits one of the four declared modules.
oracle.observable: The declared command argv lists and scope-validation result record module membership and exclusions during contract/terminal validation.

acceptance.then: The command-scope validation artifact demonstrates the required per-group, predecessor, and A4 four-module coverage relationships.
acceptance.when: During targeted-command scope checking and A4 Q6/terminal validation, inspect the frozen argv arrays and evaluate their module membership against the binding guidance.
